QuestInfo.name: [Fight for Azwan] A Fool and His Marbles  2
QuestInfo.0: What? Hilla has all the Shamaness Marbles? Speak to Longoria.
QuestInfo.1:
Iason favored Hilla long ago and gave her control of the Shamaness Marbles. If you want to have any chance against her magic, you'll need to make new marbles. Bring back the materials.

QuestInfo.2: Longoria began crafting a new Shamaness Marble.

0.0: The Shamaness Marble isn't generally used outside of important rituals. The king was always in charge of keeping an eye on them...
0.1: But the king was quite fond of Hilla. He doted on her and gave her gifts without thinking. Don't get me wrong, it was never gratuitous. Hilla was a powerful shamaness who protected our kingdom...
0.2: No one could have seen that coming. But it's in the past now and this is the present. If you want me to make a new marble, I will try.

yes.0: I'm going to need the right ingredients. You should be able to get them relatively easily.

1.0: The king acted like a fool... but I am just as much to blame. I was his teacher. I drilled obstinance and self-righteousness into him from the day he was born.

yes.0: Is this all that can be done right now?
